name: Team Bulbasaur: Grass Momentum & Early Fusion Synergy
archetype: Fast physical setup sweepers, sleep & Leech Seed attrition, and Grass/Flying hybrid coverage.
gym_duel_rationale: Brock enforces a strict 2v2 duel. Enter the arena with Bulbasaur (4x Grass STAB Vine Whip) and Mankey (Low Kick scales off Onix's heavy weight). Bench your aerial fusions to avoid Rock Tomb.

roster.progression_notes: All 4 moves learned naturally by Lv. 9-12. Vine Whip deals 4x super-effective damage to Brock. Evolution to Ivysaur occurs at Lv. 16 in Chapter 2.
Early fusion combining Tangela's Grass control with Pidgey's Flying speed. Gust cleans up Viridian Forest bugs effortlessly.
Low Kick deals damage based on target weight, crushing Onix. Defiant punishes stat-lowering moves like Brock's Sand-Attack.
Early double-bug fusion available immediately upon Caterpie and Weedle reaching Lv. 10. Pairs Confusion targeting low SpD with twin-strike physical poison.

flex_bench.role: Poison Physical Striker & Double Kick Coverage
flex_bench.why_use: Caught on Route 22. Learns Double Kick at Lv. 12, providing Fighting-type super-effective coverage against Rock/Ground opponents.
Caught on Route 22. High Base 70 Speed with Peck and Leer.

active_fusions: Tangela/Pidgey (Early Grass/Flying aerial pivot with Gust and Vine Whip)
Butterfree/Beedrill (Bug/Poison status duo with Compound Eyes 97.5% Sleep Powder)
unfuse_recommendations: 1. Retain Tangela/Pidgey until reaching Cerulean City in Chapter 2.
2. Unfuse Tangela/Pidgey at Cerulean Poké Mart ($300) to fuse newly evolved Pidgeotto onto Ivysaur.
upcoming_fusions: Ivysaur/Pidgeotto (Chapter 2 Grass/Flying aerial tank for Misty's Water Gym)
